input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Read room_types and edits, inspect original room interiors, then use revise_bim/set_space_role to choose a plausible use, including a reasonable inference from building context. Prefer a broad listed type over unknown; avoid spending excessive effort distinguishing similar plausible uses. Read remaining cells with read_candidate_items; preserve physical partitions.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Dimension chain from North_view.png resolves to z=[1.6,2.6], matching the already-declared F1 window heights.

claims.reason: North_view.png shows the building's total height 6600mm split by a mid-height horizontal line into an upper 3600mm zone and a lower 3000mm zone. The lower zone (F1) carries its own vertical dimension chain, top-down: 400 (gap from the F1/F2 dividing line down to window head), 1000 (window height), 1600 (gap from window sill down to the F1 floor line). World origin_m=3.0 is the F1/F2 dividing line (absolute z=3.0, matching F1 ceiling_height=3.0 from z_floor=0), direction=-1 walks downward. Segment 1 (index 1, the 1000mm window band) yields absolute z=[1.6,2.6], matching the head/sill I already declared for every F1 exterior window. Applying the same North-facade-derived family to the South and East F1 windows is an explicit unverified assumption (South/East elevations not yet cross-checked figure-by-figure), recorded as such.
unresolved: South_view.png and East_view.png not individually re-measured for their own window chains; F1 south/east windows assumed to share the north family.

decision.reason: Dimension chain from North_view.png resolves to z=[4.0,5.8], matching the already-declared F2 window heights.

claims.reason: North_view.png shows total building height 6600mm split by a mid-height line into upper 3600mm (F2) and lower 3000mm (F1) zones. The upper zone carries its own vertical dimension chain, top-down from the building top (absolute z=6.6, i.e. F1(3.0)+F2 ceiling_height(3.6)): 800 (gap from roof/parapet down to window head), 1800 (window height), 1000 (gap from window sill down to the F1/F2 dividing line at z=3.0). World origin_m=6.6, direction=-1. Segment 1 (index 1, the 1800mm window band) yields absolute z=[4.0,5.8], matching the head/sill already declared for every F2 exterior window. Applying this single North-facade-derived family to the South, East and West F2 windows (office and corridor windows, which look visually similar in width proportion though not individually re-measured) is an explicit unverified assumption.
